# Lunar surface

`moon-surface.webp` (256 × 256, sky and small icons) and `moon-surface-hd.webp`
(512 × 512, the Moon card, generated by `scripts/generate-moon-surface.py`) are crops
and resizes of the NASA Scientific Visualization Studio full Moon rendering,
`phase_full.1571.tif`.

- Source: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/5587/
- Original: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a005000/a005048/phase_full.1571.tif
- Credit: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio; Ernie Wright (USRA),
  Noah Petro (NASA/GSFC), James Tralie (eMITS).
- Surface data: LRO/LOLA and the LROC WAC natural-color mosaic (ASU).
- Usage guidelines: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/

This is a static surface illustration with north up, not a live photograph.
PLUVIA shades the full-Moon texture locally (Lommel-Seeliger with a soft terminator) from the SunCalc phase.
The illustration does not model libration or the observer's viewing angle.
